item.title: 625 Madison Negative Declaration CEQR No. 26DCP157M
item.description:
City Planning | Special Materials | Notice
In plain English (machine-written): The Department of City Planning issued a negative declaration for a project at 625 Madison, finding it would have no significant environmental impact under City Environmental Quality Review (CEQR) reference 26DCP157M.
